title: Inference latency and capacity
description: vLLM latency and capacity on the DGX Spark pair, built only from the recorded metric-name list (dgx-spark results/vllm-metric-names-506e66caa3ef.txt).

links.title: dgx-spark benchmark results
links.tooltip: Benchmark run manifests (placement, profile, image) in the dgx-spark repository

list.name: model_alias
list.label: Model alias
list.description: vLLM labels its series with model_name, which carries the served model name (the alias dgx-spark ships as model_alias on Loki streams).

panels.title: Time to first token p50 / p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))

panels.title: Queue, prefill and decode time p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_bucket{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])))
sum by (model_name) (vllm:num_requests_running{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"})
sum by (model_name) (vllm:num_requests_waiting{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"})

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description: The value vLLM reports in vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc, unscaled.

targets.expr: max by (model_name) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"})
sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m]))

panels.title: Prompt and generation tokens per second

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m]))
sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m]))

sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m])), 1e-9)
sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job="dgx-spark-vllm", cluster="dgx-spark", model_name=~"$model_alias"}[5m]))
